text:
At a wedding I whispered to a guy next to me,
"Isn't the bride a right ugly dog"
"Do you mind. That's my daughter you're talking about"
"I'm sorry, I didn't know you were her father''...
"I'm not . . . I'm her fucking mother.
gist: At a wedding a guest insults the bride to a man next to him, apologizes for insulting her father, and learns the masculine-looking person is her mother.

characters.looks: wedding guest in suit, whispering, embarrassed
masculine-looking woman, short hair, suit, stubble
homely bride in white dress

adaptNote: Keep the mother's earlier lines free of gendered verb forms.

text:
A girl once told me, “If you lost about 50 pounds you’d be cute”
I told her, “if I lost 50 pounds I’d be talking to your friends!”
gist: A woman says he would be cute if he lost weight, and he retorts that then he would be talking to her prettier friends.

young woman, condescending look, drink in hand

text:
Bad Math Grade
A little boy comes home from school and tells his father, "I got an F in math today."
His father replies, "What happened?"
The boy says, "Well, my teacher asked me, 'What's 3 times 2', and I said 6.'"
The father replies, "Well, that's correct."
The boy says, "I know. Then she asked me, 'What's 2 times 3.'"
The father then replies, "What the fuck is the difference?"
The boys says, "That's what I said!"
gist: Boy failed math after asking what the difference is between 3 times 2 and 2 times 3, and his father's swearing reaction repeats exactly what the boy said.

characters.looks: little boy with backpack, report card, innocent face
dad in armchair with newspaper, exasperated
strict woman teacher with glasses

text:
A wife asks her programmer husband to go to the store..
'Can you go down to the store, and get a gallon of milk, and if they have eggs, get 6.'
Later on he returns home and she looks at his purchases and says 'Why the fuck do you have 6 gallons of milk?'
He responded 'They had eggs.'
gist: Programmer told to buy milk and, if there are eggs, get six, parses it literally and returns with six gallons of milk because the store had eggs.

characters.looks: woman in casual home clothes, hands on hips, exasperated
nerdy man, glasses, hoodie, carrying many milk jugs

text:
I was walking with my girlfriend when a random guy whistled at her and said "nice ass". She was clearly annoyed and demanded I say something.
So I turned around and said: "Thank you I've been doing squats"
gist: A stranger whistles 'nice ass' at a man's girlfriend, she demands he respond, and he thanks the stranger as if the compliment were for himself.

text:
I went to the doctors recently He said: “Don’t eat anything fatty” I said: “What, like bacon and burgers?”
He said, “No. Fatty, don’t eat anything."
gist: Doctor's advice 'don't eat anything fatty' turns out to be 'Fatty, don't eat anything', addressed to the patient.

wordplay.explanation: 'Anything fatty' (fatty food) re-parsed as 'Fatty' (insulting address) + 'don't eat anything'.

blunt doctor in white coat with clipboard
